title: The Human Chair
synopsis: Ziwen receives a mysterious letter from an anonymous sender and can’t help but read it.

fullText.simplified:
早上，子文的丈夫上班后，她终于有了自己的时间。和以前一样，她把自己关进了书房里。现在她正在写一本小说。
    子文是一位美女小说家，她的小说很受欢迎。现在，她的人气比她当市长丈夫的人气还高。她几乎每天都会收到好几封来信，都是喜欢她小说的人寄给她的。
    今天也一样，她收到了三封来信。子文在书桌前坐下，在开始工作前，她要先看一下今天收到的来信。
    虽然这些信都差不多，都是一些“我很喜欢你的小说”、“你的小说真的太好看了”这样的话，但出于礼貌，只要是寄给她的，她都会看一下。
    子文先从短的信看起，在看了两封信后，最后一封信很厚，像是有稿子在里面。过去也经常有人像这样突然寄稿子来，这样的稿子一般都比较无聊。子文想看一眼稿子的标题，所以还是打开了信封。
    果然，是一本很厚的稿子。可是不知道为什么，上面没有标题，也没有作者的名字，而是一上来就以“文文”开头，好像认识她很久了的样子。奇怪，这么说还是一封信吧？她又往下看了两三行，慢慢地她有一种不好的感觉。然而，好奇心还是让她继续看了下去……

文文：
    您突然收到我这个不认识的男人的来信，而且还叫您“文文”，您一定感到非常奇怪。我知道这样很不礼貌，但是我必须告诉您，我这段时间来做错的很多事情。
    这几个月来，我一直过着隐形人的生活。在这个世界上，没有一个人知道我所做的事情。如果没有什么特别的事情，可能我不会再回到这个世界上了。
    然而，最近，我的心情发生了一些变化。我不得不向您认错。只是，我这么说，您一定不知道我说的是什么意思。所以，请您一定要读完这封信。读完后，您就能明白我为什么会有这样的心情，也会明白我为什么要向您认错了。
fullText.traditional:
早上，子文的丈夫上班後，她終於有了自己的時間。和以前一樣，她把自己關進了書房裡。現在她正在寫一本小說。
    子文是一位美女小說家，她的小說很受歡迎。現在，她的人氣比她當市長丈夫的人氣還高。她幾乎每天都會收到好幾封來信，都是喜歡她小說的人寄給她的。
    今天也一樣，她收到了三封來信。子文在書桌前坐下，在開始工作前，她要先看一下今天收到的來信。
    雖然這些信都差不多，都是一些“我很喜歡你的小說”、“你的小說真的太好看了”這樣的話，但出於禮貌，只要是寄給她的，她都會看一下。
    子文先從短的信看起，在看了兩封信後，最後一封信很厚，像是有稿子在裡面。過去也經常有人像這樣突然寄稿子來，這樣的稿子一般都比較無聊。子文想看一眼稿子的標題，所以還是打開了信封。
    果然，是一本很厚的稿子。可是不知道為什麼，上面沒有標題，也沒有作者的名字，而是一上來就以“文文”開頭，好像認識她很久了的樣子。奇怪，這麼說還是一封信吧？她又往下看了兩三行，慢慢地她有一種不好的感覺。然而，好奇心還是讓她繼續看了下去……

文文：
    您突然收到我這個不認識的男人的來信，而且還叫您“文文”，您一定感到非常奇怪。我知道這樣很不禮貌，但是我必須告訴您，我這段時間來做錯的很多事情。
    這幾個月來，我一直過著隱形人的生活。在這個世界上，沒有一個人知道我所做的事情。如果沒有什麼特別的事情，可能我不會再回到這個世界上了。
    然而，最近，我的心情發生了一些變化。我不得不向您認錯。只是，我這麼說，您一定不知道我說的是什麼意思。所以，請您一定要讀完這封信。讀完後，您就能明白我為什麼會有這樣的心情，也會明白我為什麼要向您認錯了。

sentences.simplified: 今天也一样，她收到了三封来信。

sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān yě yí yàng tā shōu dào le sān fēng lái xìn

sentences.simplified: 子文在书桌前坐下，在开始工作前，她要先看一下今天收到的来信。
sentences.traditional: 子文在書桌前坐下，在開始工作前，她要先看一下今天收到的來信。

sentences.simplified: 但出于礼貌，只要是寄给她的，她都会看一下。

sentences.english: .. out of courtesy, as long as it was sent to her, she would read it.

sentences.simplified: 子文先从短的信看起，在看了两封信后，
sentences.traditional: 子文先從短的信看起，在看了兩封信後，

sentences.english: Ziwen started with the short letters and read the first two.

sentences.simplified: 最后一封信很厚，像是有稿子在里面。
sentences.traditional: 最後一封信很厚，像是有稿子在裡面。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu yì fēng xìn hěn hòu xiàng shì yǒu gǎo zi zài lǐ miàn

sentences.simplified: 过去也经常有人像这样突然寄稿子来，这样的稿子一般都比较无聊。
sentences.traditional: 過去也經常有人像這樣突然寄稿子來，這樣的稿子一般都比較無聊。
sentences.pinyin: guò qù yě jīng cháng yǒu rén xiàng zhè yàng tū rán jì gǎo zi lái zhè yàng de gǎo zi yì bān dōu bǐ jiào wú liáo
sentences.english: In the past, people often sent manuscripts like this. These manuscripts were generally quite boring.

sentences.simplified: 子文想看一眼稿子的标题，所以还是打开了信封。
sentences.traditional: 子文想看一眼稿子的標題，所以還是打開了信封。
sentences.pinyin: zǐ wén xiǎng kàn yì yǎn gǎo zi de biāo tí suǒ yǐ hái shi dǎ kāi le xìn fēng
sentences.english: Ziwen wanted to take a look at the title of the manuscript, so she decided to open the letter.

sentences.simplified: 果然，是一本很厚的稿子。
sentences.traditional: 果然，是一本很厚的稿子。
sentences.pinyin: guǒ rán shì yì běn hěn hòu de gǎo zi
sentences.english: Sure enough, it was a very thick manuscript.

sentences.simplified: 可是不知道为什么，上面没有标题，也没有作者的名字，
sentences.traditional: 可是不知道為什麼，上面沒有標題，也沒有作者的名字，

sentences.english: However, for some reason, there was no title at the top, nor the author’s name, ..

sentences.simplified: 而是一上来就以“文文”开头，好像认识她很久了的样子。
sentences.traditional: 而是一上來就以“文文”開頭，好像認識她很久了的樣子。
sentences.pinyin: ér shì yí shàng lái jiù yǐ wén wén kāi tóu hǎo xiàng rèn shi tā hěn jiǔ le de yàng zi
sentences.english: .. instead, it started with “Wenwen,” as if they had known her for a very long time.

sentences.simplified: 奇怪，这么说还是一封信吧？
sentences.traditional: 奇怪，這麼說還是一封信吧？
sentences.pinyin: qí guài zhè me shuō hái shi yì fēng xìn ba
sentences.english: How strange, can something like this still be considered a letter?

sentences.simplified: 她又往下看了两三行，慢慢地她有一种不好的感觉。
sentences.traditional: 她又往下看了兩三行，慢慢地她有一種不好的感覺。
sentences.pinyin: tā yòu wǎng xià kàn le liǎng sān háng màn man de tā yǒu yì zhǒng bù hǎo de gǎn jué
sentences.english: She continued to read on for two to three lines, slowly developing an unpleasant feeling.

sentences.simplified: 然而，好奇心还是让她继续看了下去……
sentences.traditional: 然而，好奇心還是讓她繼續看了下去……
sentences.pinyin: rán ér hào qí xīn hái shi ràng tā jì xù kàn le xià qù
sentences.english: However, curiosity lead her to continue reading on…

sentences.simplified: 文文：
sentences.traditional: 文文：
sentences.pinyin: wén wén
sentences.english: Wenwen:

sentences.simplified: 您突然收到我这个不认识的男人的来信，
sentences.traditional: 您突然收到我這個不認識的男人的來信，
sentences.pinyin: nín tū rán shōu dào wǒ zhè ge bú rèn shi de nán rén de lái xìn
sentences.english: You suddenly received this letter from me, a man you do not know.

sentences.simplified: 而且还叫您“文文”，您一定感到非常奇怪。
sentences.traditional: 而且還叫您“文文”，您一定感到非常奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: ér qiě hái jiào nín wén wén nín yí dìng gǎn dào fēi cháng qí guài
sentences.english: What’s more, I call you “Wenwen.” You must find this extremely strange.

sentences.simplified: 我知道这样很不礼貌，但是我必须告诉您，我这段时间来做错的很多事情。
sentences.traditional: 我知道這樣很不禮貌，但是我必須告訴您，我這段時間來做錯的很多事情。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhī dào zhè yàng hěn bú lǐ mào dàn shì wǒ bì xū gào su nín wǒ zhè duàn shí jiān lái zuò cuò de hěn duō shì qing
sentences.english: I know this is very impolite, but I must tell you that during this time I have done many bad things.

sentences.simplified: 这几个月来，我一直过着隐形人的生活。
sentences.traditional: 這幾個月來，我一直過著隱形人的生活。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jǐ ge yuè lái wǒ yì zhí guò zhe yǐn xíng rén de shēng huó
sentences.english: In the last few months, I have continuously been living the life of an invisible man.

sentences.simplified: 在这个世界上，没有一个人知道我所做的事情。
sentences.traditional: 在這個世界上，沒有一個人知道我所做的事情。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè ge shì jiè shang méi yǒu yí ge rén zhī dào wǒ suǒ zuò de shì qing
sentences.english: Not a single person in this world knows about the things that I have done.

sentences.simplified: 如果没有什么特别的事情，可能我不会再回到这个世界上了。
sentences.traditional: 如果沒有什麼特別的事情，可能我不會再回到這個世界上了。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ méi yǒu shén me tè bié de shì qing kě néng wǒ bú huì zài huí dào zhè ge shì jiè shang le
sentences.english: If something special hadn’t happened, I might not have come back to this world again.

sentences.simplified: 然而，最近，我的心情发生了一些变化。
sentences.traditional: 然而，最近，我的心情發生了一些變化。
sentences.pinyin: rán ér zuì jìn wǒ de xīn qíng fā shēng le yì xiē biàn huà
sentences.english: Yet, lately, my frame of mind has experienced some kind of change.

sentences.simplified: 我不得不向您认错。
sentences.traditional: 我不得不向您認錯。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù dé bù xiàng nín rèn cuò
sentences.english: I must apologize to you.

sentences.simplified: 只是，我这么说，您一定不知道我说的是什么意思。
sentences.traditional: 只是，我這麼說，您一定不知道我說的是什麼意思。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ shì wǒ zhè me shuō nín yí dìng bù zhī dào wǒ shuō de shì shén me yì si
sentences.english: But, if I put it this way, you definitely will not know the meaning behind my words.

sentences.simplified: 所以，请您一定要读完这封信。
sentences.traditional: 所以，請您一定要讀完這封信。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ qǐng nín yí dìng yào dú wán zhè fēng xìn
sentences.english: So, please, you must read this letter until the end.

sentences.simplified: 读完后，您就能明白我为什么会有这样的心情，也会明白我为什么要向您认错了。
sentences.traditional: 讀完後，您就能明白我為什麼會有這樣的心情，也會明白我為什麼要向您認錯了。
sentences.pinyin: dú wán hòu nín jiù néng míng bai wǒ wèi shén me huì yǒu zhè yàng de xīn qíng yě huì míng bai wǒ wèi shén me yào xiàng nín rèn cuò le
sentences.english: After you have finished reading, you will be able to understand why I feel this way and why I am apologizing to you.

sentence_translations: In the morning, after Ziwen’s husband had gone to work, she finally had time for herself.
Just as before, she locked herself away inside the study.
She was currently in the middle of writing a novel.
Ziwen was a beautiful female novelist and her novels were very popular.
She was now even more popular than her husband who was the city mayor.
She received several letters nearly everyday, all sent by people who liked her novels.
This day was also the same. She received three letters.
Ziwen sat in front of her desk and before starting work, she first read the three letters she received that day.
Even though these letters were all more or less the same, ..
.. “I really like your novels,” “your novels are really amazing,” that kind of thing, ..
.. out of courtesy, as long as it was sent to her, she would read it.
Ziwen started with the short letters and read the first two.
The final letter was very thick, like there was a manuscript inside.
In the past, people often sent manuscripts like this. These manuscripts were generally quite boring.
Ziwen wanted to take a look at the title of the manuscript, so she decided to open the letter.
Sure enough, it was a very thick manuscript.
However, for some reason, there was no title at the top, nor the author’s name, ..
.. instead, it started with “Wenwen,” as if they had known her for a very long time.
How strange, can something like this still be considered a letter?
She continued to read on for two to three lines, slowly developing an unpleasant feeling.
However, curiosity lead her to continue reading on…
Wenwen:
You suddenly received this letter from me, a man you do not know.
What’s more, I call you “Wenwen.” You must find this extremely strange.
I know this is very impolite, but I must tell you that during this time I have done many bad things.
In the last few months, I have continuously been living the life of an invisible man.
Not a single person in this world knows about the things that I have done.
If something special hadn’t happened, I might not have come back to this world again.
Yet, lately, my frame of mind has experienced some kind of change.
I must apologize to you.
But, if I put it this way, you definitely will not know the meaning behind my words.
So, please, you must read this letter until the end.
After you have finished reading, you will be able to understand why I feel this way and why I am apologizing to you.
